strings.tagline: The modern way to learn authentic Islamic knowledge
strings.authenticity: Graded Sahih — agreed upon by Bukhari & Muslim, the highest tier of authenticity in hadith science.
strings.tapHint: Tap any word to discover its meaning
strings.reflectionPh: What stood out about intention today?
strings.actionPh: e.g. renew my intention before I pray
strings.companionNote: AI explanations stay clearly separate from the religious text and scholarly commentary.
strings.companionUnavailable: The study companion needs the backend running with an API key configured — start it with `npm run api` and set VITE_ALMINHEJ_API_BASE_URL.
strings.companionError: The companion couldn't answer just now. Please try again.
strings.quizWrong: Worth another look — check the highlighted answer.
strings.welcomeQ: How would you like to read the hadith?
strings.immersiveDesc: Read the sacred text as-is; translation hidden by default — built for Arabic speakers.
strings.guidedDesc: Keep a helper paragraph under the text while you learn — great for newcomers.
strings.memorizeHint: Faded words are hidden — tap to reveal and test your memory
strings.libraryIntro: Every book cited here is digitally indexed — from full text down to not-yet-started.
strings.author: Author
strings.sourceEmptyNote: Our team hasn't reached this part yet. Your vote helps us prioritize what to digitize next.
strings.libraryShelfTag: Original texts, indexed page by page
strings.bookNotOpen: This book isn't open for preview yet
strings.tocLocked: This chapter hasn't been opened yet
strings.nextPageLocked: Next page is still being digitized
strings.homeGraphDesc: Every text links to its sources, chains, and commentaries — revealed as you go deeper.
strings.pathChooseDesc: Pick a starting point and the path builds itself from the connections already in the knowledge graph.
strings.pathCompleteTitle: You've reached the end of this path
strings.pathCompleteDesc: No remaining connection from where you are leads to something readable yet. Start a new path, or explore the library.
strings.pathBecauseSimilarTo: Marked similar to what you just read
strings.pathTraceableNote: Every step follows a real connection in the graph.
strings.authSignInSubtitle: Your path, bookmarks, and notes are saved to your account.
strings.authRegisterSubtitle: Register with an email and a password to save your progress.
strings.authToSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
strings.authUnavailable: Sign-in needs the AlMinhej API backend — start it with `npm run api` and set VITE_ALMINHEJ_API_BASE_URL.
strings.authEmailTaken: An account with that email already exists.
strings.authPasswordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
strings.authNetworkError: Could not reach the server. Is the API running?
strings.authGenericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
strings.searchHint: Every hadith, book, narrator, verse and concept in one index — in Arabic or English.
strings.searchError: Search is unavailable — the AlMinhej API did not answer.
strings.exploreHint: Where this node sits in the graph — its neighbors, its chronology, and what it points to.
strings.exploreEmpty: Nothing else is connected to this node yet.
strings.exploreError: Explore is unavailable — the AlMinhej API did not answer.
strings.exploreNotFound: No published node has that address.
